definition: The Mainfranken region comprises the independent cities of Würzburg and Schweinfurt plus the districts of Bad Kissingen, Haßberge, Kitzingen, Main-Spessart, Rhön-Grabfeld, Schweinfurt, and Würzburg.
matching_rule: Include a company when at least one verified company site is inside one of the configured cities or districts. Do not include a company solely because its parent company or an unverified source has a wider regional presence.
data_quality_rule: Normalize district and city variants before filtering, preserve the original value, and send ambiguous or multi-region records to human review.
